meta.notes: Rule parameters for the 8 systems (docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §5) plus the importance rule (§9) and the intent contract parameters (docs/INTENT_SCHEMA.md). Every number here is v0.1 tunable pack data — balance changes never touch code (INV-3). Values pinned by MVP_SCOPE or EVENT_SCHEMA examples are marked with a source note.

time.notes: MVP_SCOPE §8: full day ≈ 1440 ticks; 1 hour ≈ 60 ticks; typical action 2–8 ticks (see actions.json)

position_visibility.notes: node-based model: locations are graph nodes (entities.json exits); visibility input → knowledge output, never duplicate fields (MVP_SCOPE §9). The status modifiers on perception live with the perception skill (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers — single owner); smoke_penalty feeds the perception system (iter-3)

systems.notes: SCHED-1: reads/writes annotations are data; the scheduler builds the per-tick pass order from the per_tick subset and fails loudly on write-write ambiguity without before/after hints (docs/blueprint/phase0.md §2). Systems flip per_tick as their iterations land (fire: iter-2; knowledge/relations/states: iter-3; director: iter-4)

checks.notes: Opposed check (INTENT_SCHEMA §5): attacker total = skill base + status modifiers + d20 vs defender total; defender = the named skill of the defender entity (target / best-in-location excluding the actor) or the flat difficulty (environment); tie → defender; defender wins by ≥ failure_margin → total failure where the action distinguishes it. Skill numbers are v0.1 defaults; the difficulty column of MVP_SCOPE §7 seeds the per-action values in actions.json

relations.notes: ev_0007 pins suspicion 0→25 together with status unknown→suspect; 50/75 are v0.1 defaults for hooks the spec names but does not number. Suspicion state changes land with the crime system (iter-3)

knowledge.notes: EVENT_SCHEMA §3: rumor = transfer event with one-step fidelity decay; distortion from source incompleteness (D-007). Trusted tellers spread faster (§6 matrix). Transfer itself lands iter-3

states.notes: modifiers feed perception (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers) and behavior; no group reputation in v0 (D-006). Attention is the distract action's target state; decay passes land with the states system (iter-3)

fire.notes: the one transition primitive (phase0 §2, Brogue promoteTile donor): a pack-declared layer — flag-gated ignition, stochastic per-tick spread within the location, SEEDED smoke/burnout follow-ups, alarm with fear spikes. rules.json fire section restructured into this generic layer at iter-2 (same v0.1 numbers); position_visibility.smoke_penalty stays with the perception input it belongs to

transitions.notes: generic transition engine (core/transitions.py) iterates pack-declared layers by name — core code carries no layer names (INV-3)

crime_watch.notes: watch change = knowledge-transfer event between guards (D-006); 'document check in two hours' = 120 ticks seeded at event time (MVP_SCOPE §11). The reacting crime system lands iter-3; the steal-failure hooks seeded by actions.json reference document_check.hook

director.buffer: hooks seeded at event time, never invented later
director.notes: D-005: the director releases already-seeded consequences; a complication from nowhere is a bug. Director-off A/B is mandatory (T8). Lands iter-4

importance.notes: MVP_SCOPE §9: computed from entities touched + irreversibility + far hooks → low/medium/high; never by feel. Mapping thresholds are v0.1 defaults
